what_this_is: Cells E and F re-run after the Stage-B defect was fixed in jevx/training/curriculum.py. Before the fix _CurriculumModelView.condition_options was assigned once at construction from stage_a_epochs < 1 and never updated when the stage flipped to B, so every Stage-B step still called the model with condition_options=False and the interaction residual was dropped whatever the lambda ramp wrote into the head. The old E/F numbers below are therefore state-only-for-4-epochs plus an inert ramp, and are kept here only as the superseded comparison.

fix.mechanism: _StageController now owns the per-call flag as well as the scale. _StageController.condition_options is a pure function of the stage (False in A, True in B); apply_stage() pushes it into the model view through _CurriculumModelView.set_condition_options(), once per epoch (begin_epoch) and again before every training step (advance). EpochRecord.condition_options records the flag the epoch ran under, read back off the view.
